state: Backend deployed and pending-review snapshot imported; App Store release not performed
gates: Resolve district ambiguities and record source evidence before any publication
Validate upgrade, notifications, sharing and withdrawal on real device
Owner makes release decision; existing PHP/MySQL remain online

importProcedure.review: Review manifest project, collection, batch, document count and sha256; keep immutable manifest outside source control
importProcedure.credentials: An explicitly configured Admin SDK credential for this project is required; never put credentials in the manifest or command line
importProcedure.resumption: Re-run same manifest; exact matches are skipped, conflicts are reported with exit code 2 and never overwritten
importProcedure.visibility: All imported documents remain pending-review and are absent from public search

rollbackProcedure.scope: Delete only documents that still exactly match the manifest, including pending-review status and migration batch
rollbackProcedure.conflicts: Edited or published documents remain untouched and require separate review
rollbackProcedure.failure: Operations are per-document transactions; interrupted imports/rollbacks may be partial and can safely resume with the same manifest
rollbackProcedure.excluded: Does not reverse published content, app rollout, notification settings, billing or API enablement; preserve their own recovery plans
